import json, os, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('/Volumes/KINGSTON/AIVERSE-builds/building-caverns-gate-source')
binary=root.parent/'building-caverns-gate-build/aiversemcp'
env=dict(os.environ,AIVERSE_PYTHON=sys.executable)
with subprocess.Popen([binary,'--engine',root,'--no-editor','--port','0'],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,text=True,env=env) as proc:
    def send(ident,method,params):
        proc.stdin.write(json.dumps(dict(id=ident,jsonrpc='2.0',method=method,params=params))+'\n')
        proc.stdin.flush()
        row=json.loads(proc.stdout.readline())
        assert row['id']==ident and 'error' not in row,row
        return row['result']
    def call(ident,name,args=None):
        r=send(ident,'tools/call',dict(name='feature_readiness_'+name,arguments=args or {}))
        assert not r.get('isError'),r
        return json.loads(r['content'][0]['text'])
    send(1,'initialize',{})
    before=call(2,'status_get')
    start=call(3,'refresh')
    for i in range(4,124):
        result=call(i,'status_get')
        if not result['busy'] and result['runCount']>before['runCount']:break
        time.sleep(.5)
    assert not result['busy'] and result['exitCode']==0,result
    snap=call(130,'get')
    sha=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip()
    assert snap['snapshotOnly'] and snap['sha']==sha
    page=call(131,'query',dict(section='features',offset=1,limit=2))
    assert page['sha']==sha and page['total']>=10 and len(page['items'])==2,page
    print('PASS native stdio report generation, job completion, snapshot SHA and paginated feature query')
    proc.stdin.close()
